title: Silas and the Provision
author: Rafael Almeida
blurb: Wren Kavanagh, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
